title: Red Hat Security Advisory: openssh security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for OpenSSH addressing three vulnerabilities: a security bypass in SFTP due to command-line argument parsing (CVE-2026-59997), an undocumented GSSAPIStrictAcceptorCheck behavior affecting Windows Active Directory security (CVE-2026-59998), and a denial of service via excessive GSSAPI authentication attempts (CVE-2026-60000). These issues impact OpenSSH implementations on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 across multiple architectures. The update is rated as having moderate security impact.
